entries.topic: The law, the rulings, and enforcement

claims.text: Geneva IV Art 49(6): 'The Occupying Power shall not deport or transfer parts of its own civilian population into the territory it occupies.' Art 49(1) bans forcible transfers of protected persons 'regardless of their motive'.
Hansell letter 21 Apr 1978: settlements 'inconsistent with international law'; reads 49(6) to cover any transfer including state assistance.
Reagan 1981 said settlements 'not illegal'; Baker 1991 called them 'an obstacle to peace' and said calling them illegal 'is not our policy'.
Pompeo Nov 2019: US no longer views settlements as inconsistent with international law; Blinken 23 Feb 2024: settlements 'inconsistent with international law'.

UNSC 2334, 23 Dec 2016, 14–0 with US abstention: settlements 'no legal validity', 'flagrant violation'; states to distinguish Israel from territories occupied since 1967; Netanyahu called it 'swan song of the old world'; Israel said it would not comply; first SG report March 2017 found no steps taken.

ICJ 19 Jul 2024: continued presence unlawful; end it as rapidly as possible; cease new settlement and evacuate settlers; reparation; states not to recognize or aid; systemic discrimination; 11 of 15 judges agreed with all findings; Sebutinde dissented; Netanyahu: 'The Jewish people are not occupiers in their own land'.
UNGA 18 Sep 2024 124–14–43 demanded end of presence within 12 months; US voted against ('inflammatory'); Israel's Danon called it 'diplomatic terrorism'.
Palestine joined ICC 1 Apr 2015; preliminary exam Jan 2015; investigation opened 3 Mar 2021; Netanyahu Apr 2021: Israel does not recognise ICC authority; Israel and US not parties.
Trump EO Feb 2025 sanctioned ICC officials, citing Netanyahu warrant as 'baseless'; four judges sanctioned 5 Jun 2025; judges sued June 2026.
Levy Report 9 Jul 2012, commissioned by Netanyahu: presence not occupation, settlements legal, outposts should be legalized; never formally adopted; US rejected legitimacy of settlement activity.
